title: OrthoFi and Greyfinch Plan Practice Management Integration
html:
By News Staff

November 25, 2026

Share

OrthoFi and Greyfinch are developing an integration intended to connect patient information across OrthoFi’s patient conversion, insurance, and financial platform, and Greyfinch’s cloud-based practice management system. The companies say it will link workflows from initial consultation through ongoing payment management.

According to the companies, the planned integration is intended to synchronize patient information, appointments, and financial records between the platforms, display payment statuses on patient profiles, and connect users’ workflows through platform-to-platform navigation. OrthoFi and Greyfinch say these features are designed to reduce duplicate data entry and routine administrative work. They also say the integration will provide practices with increased visibility and reporting.

OrthoFi and Greyfinch describe the project as a response to a frequently requested integration feature from OrthoFi customers. They say disconnected systems can create fragmented workflows and increase the potential for data-entry errors.

“Our primary goals at OrthoFi have always been to make quality orthodontic care more accessible to patients and to simplify practice operations,” said Dave Ternan, co-founder and CEO of OrthoFi. “This Greyfinch integration streamlines the experience for practices, eliminating non-value-added work so teams can focus on patient care and drive higher case acceptance.”

“Greyfinch was built to provide modern practices with flexible, cloud-native tools that scale effortlessly,” said Jake Gulick, president of Greyfinch. “Integrating with OrthoFi empowers our mutual clients to deliver a best-in-class onboarding and financial experience without sacrificing workflow efficiency.”

The integration is in active development. The companies expect it to be available to practices in January 2027 and say they will announce timeline, feature, and availability details in the coming months.

More information is available at www.orthofi.com and www.greyfinch.com.
